causal_checks: After release, the bob moves because gravity pulls it downward along the arc.
The bob speeds up as it descends toward the lowest point.
The bob reaches maximum speed near the vertical lowest position.
The bob slows as it climbs the opposite side.
The bob reverses direction near the peak on each side.
Successive swing peaks are no higher than the initial release angle.
The swing amplitude gradually decreases over time.
The bob path remains a circular arc centered on the fixed pivot.
The string remains taut throughout the visible motion.
The apparatus and measurement markings do not shift while the bob oscillates.
controlled_variables: measurement camera position, framing, and perspective remain fixed
pendulum pivot and support frame remain fixed
bob mass, shape, and appearance remain constant
measurement board, protractor, level 3 label, and marked angle remain fixed
no external push, pull, or collision is applied after release
gravity acts downward and the bob remains attached to the string
expected_spec.expected_response: The bob begins at the marked medium level 3 release angle, accelerates downward along a circular arc, passes through the lowest point at maximum speed, rises to the opposite side to a similar but slightly lower height, then continues oscillating back and forth with approximately periodic motion and gradually decreasing amplitude. The string stays taut and the pivot does not move.
failure_modes: bob receives an obvious push or starts with nonzero tangential impulse
bob falls straight down instead of following an arc
bob detaches from the string or string goes slack
pivot, frame, board, or camera moves during the trial
bob starts from the wrong release angle or wrong side
oscillation amplitude grows without a visible cause
bob stops abruptly without damping explanation
bob swings out of the measurement plane or toward the camera
protractor, level label, or release marker disappears or changes position
motion violates pendulum timing by teleporting, jittering, or skipping frames
expected_spec.intervention: Set the pendulum_release condition to medium level 3 and release the bob from the marked angle with no push.
protected_anchors: pendulum string attached to pivot and bob
no hand or release tool visible after release
expected_spec.target_system: A simple pendulum bob suspended from a fixed pivot above a measurement board with a printed angle protractor and a marked release angle labeled level 3.
